international.title: Asylum seekers removed from UK subjected to ‘unnecessary and intimidating’ force
international.summary: Incidents include suicidal man being carried on to plane in waist, leg and ankle restraints, freedom of information data shows “Unnecessary and intimidating” behaviour was used against asylum seekers being deported under the UK’s controversial “one in, one out” scheme, including a vulnerable person being carried on to a flight in restraints, according to a report. Many of those deported to France under the scheme – which involved one asylum seeker who arrived in the UK in a small boat being forcibly returned to France in exchange for another in northern France brought legally to the UK to claim asylum – have fled conflict zones and are survivors of torture or trafficking.
